chunks: But you will come to know soon;

key_terms.كَلَّا: But you will come to know (a particle of emphasis and warning)

ai.seo_question: What does 'Kal la sawfa ta'lamun' mean in the context of Surah Al-Takathur?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a direct address to the Quraysh's obsession with material prestige, serving as a precursor to the 'Knowledge' (Ma'rifah) that will manifest at the Hour of Reckoning. It underscores the transient nature of worldly accumulation, reminding believers that true success lies in spiritual awareness rather than temporal rivalry.
